en: Sepia-toned photograph of three uniformed soldiers or border guards in a forested area. One man stands at left holding a rifle and looking through binoculars; another kneels at right with a rifle, and a third crouches in the middle restraining a dog. All wear dark tunics with rows of buttons, high boots, and peaked caps with insignia. The background shows trees and undergrowth, with no visible buildings or text.
